coverage.subject: Hoosac ridge
coverage.composition: elevated wide, ridge running across frame, valley falling away right
coverage.prompt: Wide elevated view of the forested Hoosac ridge in late winter, bare hardwoods and torn snow, the Deerfield valley cutting away below, low raking sun, long shadows in the folds of the mountain, cinematic 16:9
coverage.motion_prompt: slow lateral drift across the ridge line

coverage.subject: the two towns either side
coverage.composition: valley floor with a scatter of mill roofs, mountain wall behind
coverage.prompt: A small New England mill settlement on a valley floor in late winter, plank and brick roofs under bare trees, smoke standing from stovepipes, the dark mass of the mountain wall rising behind and filling the upper frame
coverage.motion_prompt: slow push toward the mountain wall

coverage.subject: survey map of the routes
coverage.composition: map flat to camera, ridge line and two flanking routes legible
coverage.prompt: An engraved survey map of a mountain range on laid paper, contour hatching and inked route lines running over and around the ridge, pencilled annotations in the margin, brass dividers resting across one corner, lit flat from above
coverage.motion_prompt: slow push onto the route lines

coverage.subject: freight on the long way around
coverage.composition: loaded wagon and team on a rutted grade, receding into haze
coverage.prompt: A heavily loaded freight wagon and a straining team of horses on a rutted mountain grade in late winter, teamster walking at the head, breath and dust hanging, the road climbing away into pale haze behind them

coverage.subject: surveyor's transit
coverage.composition: instrument on tripod against open sky, mountain edge behind
coverage.prompt: A brass surveyor's transit on a wooden tripod set on frozen ground, vernier scale and plumb bob clearly visible, worn field notebook weighted with a stone beside it, the mountain edge behind under a blank winter sky

coverage.subject: east portal works
coverage.composition: raw clearing and spoil bank at the mountain foot, figures for scale
coverage.prompt: A raw clearing cut into the foot of a mountain, fresh spoil bank of broken rock, timber staging and a plank shed, a few small figures standing at the rock face for scale, torn snow and mud underfoot
coverage.motion_prompt: slow lateral move across the workings

coverage.subject: gneiss and mica schist
coverage.composition: rock face filling frame, banding and mica catching the light
coverage.prompt: Extreme close view of a freshly broken gneiss and mica schist rock face, banded folded layers, flecks of mica catching a low raking light, drill scoring visible along one edge, dust in the crevices
coverage.motion_prompt: very slow push into the rock face
